description: BioTranslator performs sequentially pathway analysis and gene prioritization: A specific operator is executed for each task to translate the input gene set into semantic terms and pinpoint the pivotal-role genes on the derived semantic network. The output consists of the set of statistically significant semantic terms and the associated hub genes (the gene signature), prioritized according to their involvement in the underlying semantic topology.
name: BioTranslator Workflow
tools:
the algorithm consists of two sequential tasks:
1. pathway analysis, using the selected ontology
2. gene prioritization on the derived network of the enriched terms

outputs:
1. the enriched terms
2. the highly prioritized input genes
3. a heatmap which illustrates the association between prioritized genes and semantic clusters
